incarnation: Batman: Endgame (The New 52, Batman #35-40, 2014-2015) - the Joker
observedContract: Issue37 cover shows pale restored face, slicked-back green hair with short sides, red lips, yellowed teeth and dark bow tie.
Issue39 cover shows a dark gray/charcoal suit, pale shirt, dark bow tie and purple pocket accent. The body is seated and partly occluded by other figures.
The detached face held on issue37 is a hand-held prop in this cover, not a mask worn by the restored-faced Endgame Joker.
missingContract: No unobstructed neutral standing body or back view acquired.
Exact costume colors are affected by cover lighting; the broad current phrase purple-associated civilian clothing is insufficient to certify a purple jacket.
Weapon model and toxin dispenser geometry are not established by these covers.
